toolingCorrections: The batch outline (300 names) was written in five 60-row TSVs. Entry 190 (value305@1893) was edited into /tmp/hb-reg2-3.tsv although it had been recorded in /tmp/hb-reg2-4.tsv, so the first map build silently kept the old name for that key while the name was missing from the newer file. The key-set and duplicate checks passed because both sides still had 300 keys. Fixed by re-reading each TSV range against the brief and renaming value305@1893 -> downloadChartButtonElement in reg2-4. Lesson: the TSV shards are named by index range only; after every edit re-verify which shard actually holds the key rather than trusting the file name.

tools/check_glossary.mjs rejected 6 names on the first pass, all against real evidence in the file: statePayload (collides with the component-state payload of chunk 1) -> entityStatePayload; svgNamespace x3 -> svgUrl / smokeSvgUrl / naturalGasSvgUrl (namespace is a banned disambiguator); wispPathData / currentPathData -> wispPathDefinition / currentPathDefinition (data is banned).

tools/check_name_kinds.mjs rejected 2 shapes: value373 dropletBodyPath and value374 dropletHighlightPath hold createElementNS("path") elements but the names did not say Element; they became dropletBodyPathElement / dropletHighlightPathElement.

Section 13 of tools/verify_frontend_batch.sh failed on the first run with 'OUT changed data/app.db-shm' and 'OUT changed data/app.db-wal': the host application was running and SQLite rewrote its own WAL/SHM sidecars between the pre-batch snapshot and the check. Evidence was preserved as /tmp/hb-b9-pre-withdata.json (1729561 bytes, the only two outside-declared entries). Fix: 'data' joined DEFAULT_IGNORES in tools/lib/scan-tree.mjs with a comment explaining it is the host app's runtime state (SQLite database plus -wal/-shm, caches, logs, secrets), not source. The pre-manifest was then rebuilt (/tmp/hb-b9-pre.json, files=12267, zero data keys) with the declared file's hash restored to its pre-batch rollback sha 17d8ff28...42fbb and rebaselinedFrom / rebaselinedReason fields recording why; section 13 then reported files=12267 changed=1 missing=0 added=0 declared=1 outside-declared=0.

ownerLimited: the four sensor views each bind the same concept and the names must stay unique per file, so the family is spelled per sensor: doorWindowProperties / doorWindowState / doorWindowRenderEnvironment / doorWindowSensorElement / doorWindowVisualElement / doorWindowFrameElement versus waterLeakProperties / waterLeakState / waterLeakRenderEnvironment / waterLeakSensorElement / waterLeakVisualElement / waterLeakColor / isWaterLeakWet versus smokeProperties / smokeState / smokeSensorElement / smokeVisualElement / smokeGroundElement / smokeWispsSvgElement versus naturalGasProperties / naturalGasState / naturalGasSensorElement / naturalGasVisualElement / naturalGasHazeElement / naturalGasSvgElement

state lookup: the same states Map is reached through stateLookupEnvironment (yt@1300) / diagramRenderEnvironment / effectLayerRenderEnvironment / iconButtonRenderEnvironment / titleButtonRenderEnvironment / lightStatisticsRenderEnvironment / sensorRenderEnvironment / buttonRenderEnvironment; the studio calls it a render environment (context is banned by tools/rename-glossary.json)

buttonComponentRenderers (Ae) registers two component types at once (icon-button and device-button) from one factory, so the shared locals say button* and only the arguments distinguish them: buttonProperties / buttonRenderEnvironment / isDeviceButton / deviceButtonElement / buttonSvgElement versus iconButtonProperties / iconButtonRenderEnvironment / iconButtonElement

hover line chart: nearestPoint (value175) is the drawn point, closestPoint (arg108) is the reduce accumulator, candidatePoint the current candidate, projectedPoint the point projected onto the chart box; the tooltip can mount either on the host element or on the dialog layer, hence isTooltipOnHost / isTooltipOnDialogLayer / tooltipMountElement
light layers: lightLayerEntries / lightLayerEntry / lightLayer / isLayerActive / layerStates / syncDiagramState / baseImageUrl / lightGroupEntityId / lightGroupButtonElement

effect layer: effectLayerComponent / effectLayerRenderEnvironment / effectLayerProperties / effectAssetOverride / effectAssetUrl / isEffectAuthoredActive / effectLightVisualState / isEffectAwaitingLight / effectFadeDuration

title button: frame geometry is spelled as one family (frameWidth / frameSizeRatio / frameHeight / frameOffsetXPx / frameOffsetYPx / frameHalfSpacing / frameHalfWidth / frameCenterX / frameCenterY / frameTopEdge / frameBottomEdge / frameLeftEdge / frameRightEdge / frameCornerInset / frameInset) so the same word is never reused for two different frames in the file

droplet and wisp SVG data: dropletSvgElement / dropletBodyPathElement / dropletHighlightPathElement / wispPathElement / wispPathDefinition / currentPathElement / currentPathDefinition (svgUrl / smokeSvgUrl / naturalGasSvgUrl for the data: URIs)

newConcepts: the four sensor presentations: createDoorWindowSensorView (two panels plus an airflow element whose dots alternate by airflowDotIndex), createWaterLeakSensorView (puddle plus expanding ripples by rippleIndex), createSmokeSensorView (ground haze plus drifting wisps) and createNaturalGasSensorView (haze plus a current element); all four pick their accent colour from the sensor kind and scale a sizeRatio-bounded visual box

buttonComponentRenderers: one factory that registers the icon-button and device-button component types; it draws a corner-cut frame with soft light, glow gradient and filter, badge, and primary/secondary text, reading boundEntityState through resolveStatePayload

the navigation and door effects SVG (createNavigationEffectsSvg, CSS class hb-navigation-effects): frame / glow / inset geometry driven by intensityMultiplier, isActiveState and opacityInput, with gradientId-keyed defs

light and effect layers over a floor plan image: base image plus one image per light layer (lightLayer), an authored-active flag, pending-light detection (isEffectAwaitingLight) and an exported effect layer that can override the asset source

floor plan auto-diagram export: syncDiagramState is handed to the studio as syncFloorplanAutoDiagramState and registered as a runtime state handler; exportFolderName / componentPosition / previewSearchParams drive the search params of the exported diagram page, and the light-layer render environment is cached per diagram component (diagramRenderEnvironment)

icon button and title button component renderers: icon-button reads isIconVisible and shouldShowIcon and renders a masked icon plus glow; title-button lays out bracket paths, main/secondary line text and a marker icon inside the same corner-cut frame

light statistics control: statisticsUnitWidth/Height sized stat card rendering activeCountElement / totalCountElement / statisticsCountElement / statisticsTitleElement with an optional statistics icon

hover line chart tooltip placement: the tooltip is mounted on the host or the dialog layer and then clamped in both axes (guideLeftPercent / tooltipTranslateX / dialogLocalLeft), with handleChartPointerMove / handleChartPointerLeave and the hover guide element
the state oracle family shared with the studio runtime: isEntityStateActive / isActiveState / isEntityActive, all reading the render environment's states Map through entityId
